Joint schema head (small transformer over final hidden states) scores all options of all questions in one pass; files joint_head.safetensors, joint_schema_model.py; Apache-2.0 following Qwen base; also Cloudflare/clef-flash (9B, Qwen3.5-9B). No training recipe published. check_licence allows Apache-2.0 only (teachers.py:107) and teacher configs must carry licence (SPEC:88-90).

The card documents SGLang (sglang serve --model-path Cloudflare/clef, /v1/systemone) on H200/B200/B300 only; ggml-org/Clef-GGUF says it 'Requires https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29831' (status unchecked); no vLLM support found. Memory: ~34 GB already resident on the GPU per the extraction run notes, GB10 is 128 GB unified, GPU_STAGES guard refuses foreign GPU processes.

The jev-CLI domain is generated from the live argparse tree (generate.py _walk :60, _problems :124); tests pin operations == subcommands (test_jev_cli_domain.py:54-100). A new verb needs an Annotation (annotations.py _FACTORY :88-103, read_only=False for --apply verbs, enforced generate.py:94), >=2 PARAPHRASES (content.py:153), >=4 seed entries in >=3 phrasing classes with dry-run and apply phrasings (test_jev_cli_content.py:162,185), stays <=52 candidates, and changes cli_surface_sha256 (generate.py:227) — so the seed review pending for t34 would grow. New 'jev run' stages are generated from pipeline.REGISTRY (run.py:139-165) and get `run.<stage>` annotations (annotations.py:103), so they also touch the domain.

Stage(name, func, inputs, outputs, deps, summary) (stages.py:28) in a topologically sorted Registry (:38) with per-stage manifests (:120, :222) and staleness (:138); build_registry(registry=None) (pipeline.py:2345) accepts a fresh Registry, but REGISTRY, get_stage, effective_knobs, plan and run are bound to the global DEFAULT_REGISTRY/DEFAULT_KNOBS (:2354, :265), so a separate distill pipeline needs a small parameterisation refactor; appending stages needs none.

The Domain contract is tool-action shaped: Operation(name, description, read_only, args) (:141) with read_only required, CONTROLS=(explain, escalate) always offered (:55), letters A-Z a-z capped at 52 (:64), is_mutating treats unknown names as mutating (:21), validate requires >=1 operation and >=1 reason. Typed choice/noul/score questions would have to be faked as operations, and the read-only/mutating gate (core/gate.py decide :235) would be meaningless.

#13 proposes decide(state, questions) -> list[RawDecisionDistribution] with Choice/Boolean/Ordinal; #17 maps noul->Boolean, choice->Choice, score->Ordinal; #9 (dataset registry, all acceptance unchecked) has teacher identity and protected-split metadata but no soft-label field; #18's train/eval/test names map onto jev-factory's train / fit+selection folds / final test, and #18 never mentions the sealed held-out set.

#6 still exposes score(state, candidates) with no typed-question concept; #18 asks whether per-option probabilities suffice for score questions; Strands' config carries ordinal_smoothing 0.1 and a separate score temperature (1.192), so score is handled differently upstream.

#18 lists #7, #13, #8, #9, #12 only as Related, with no order; #13 says to 'Use #8 rather than creating a private CLEF benchmark' and takes its Strands baseline 'From #7 when available'; #7 says 'Run through the common jev-factory evaluation harness'; #8, #9 and #6 acceptance items are all unchecked; the extraction plan's risks list GPU contention with ~34 GB resident and untested PEFT merge (r11).

Checkpoints: strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21 (2026-10-05), -hobson-v19, -2B-qwen3.5-v1-2610, plus Gemma-4 E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B variants (and amazon/strands-decider-E2B-gemma4-v1-2610). #15 recommends checking a quantized model by cosine against a bf16 reference and then re-measuring downstream calibration, and notes the SystemOne 'confidence' field is not a probability (gate on max(probabilities)) — relevant to how teacher soft labels are read and how teacher quant drift is checked.

lobes owns serving: new 'decider' role (c13 confirmed) on the upstream /v1/systemone wire passed through unchanged (c19 confirmed); Clef 27B on the Orin at W4A16 via Marlin since NVFP4 needs Blackwell and the Orin is Ampere sm_87 (c4); the 2B may sit on any lobe box (c20 confirmed); the Strands decider is retrained on the DGX Sparks and 'The jev-factory work (producing decider training data / retraining) runs in a separate session ... this frame consumes its output only' (c17, c18 confirmed). Clef staging starts with a transformers sidecar running load_release_model (c12).

lobes proposes serving Strands Decider 2B unquantized bf16 (~4.5 GiB torso + fp32 head) because no official 4-bit build exists and LoRA over a 4-bit GDN hybrid on sm_87 is unvalidated; W4A16 only if memory forces it. So the distillery's quantized student is for deployments other than that bf16 lobes lane, and must not assume lobes will serve it.

scope_entries.surface: Jev System One wire (HF Cloudflare/clef card, Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B card, strands-decider README, uspraveen/Jevify docs/JEV_CONTRACT.md)
scope_entries.finding: No formal spec or OpenAPI exists; the de-facto standard is TypeSafe's Jev 'System One' POST /v1/systemone, which Clef, Strands Decider and CLM all implement: request {model, state (string|object|array), questions:{id:{type, instructions?, criteria?}}}; choice criteria {option: description} (2-255 options) -> {choice, confidence, probabilities}; score criteria = ordered level list (2-10) -> {score (expected index), legend, probabilities, confidence}; noul -> {noul: P(true)}. Multi-question records are allowed (Clef scores them jointly, Jev isolates them). Strands keeps teacher targets in a separate positional file {i, probs} keyed by row index, which is the fragility the row-keyed design avoids.

typed-decisions (Apache-2.0) stores exactly a /v1/systemone body (state, questions as JSON columns) plus a gold JSON of full per-question distributions (mean of 3 teacher samples at T=0.7, so soft gold), splits train/test, 4 workflows, 400 test cases / 2,000 decisions; CLM's finetune.py consumes this shape. jev-bench (code uspraveen/Jevify; 22 configs, 166,054 rows, mixed per-source licences in manifest.json) is one (state, question, label, soft_label) triple per row with train/validation/test, soft_label = human vote shares in 4 configs. Neither has read_only/mutating or tool structure; a tool domain maps on as one choice question whose criteria are the verbs.
#15: the SystemOne 'confidence' field is 'not a probability', gate on max(probabilities); JEV_CONTRACT.md documents per-vendor confidence formulas and that Jev's score confidence is not reproducible.

Teacher is a frozen Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B (teacher_file data/teacher_v20.jsonl, teacher_weight 1.0), applied only 'on the short-task rows where it agrees with the gold label'; kl_frozen_weight 0.3 is 'KL(frozen || student) over the option-number readout' (precompute_frozen_kl true), a pull toward the frozen start model; also ordinal_smoothing 0.1, shuffle_options true, reverse_score_prob 0.5, 1 epoch. The training code was not read, so the frozen-KL reading is unconfirmed.

/v1/rank {context, question, answers} -> {ranked:[{rank, candidate, prob}]} exists only in CLM; Strands accepts up to 4 base64 images only when served with --vision (422 otherwise), Clef takes images/videos, CLM and Jev are text-only.

scope_entries.surface: benchmarks reported by Clef / Strands / CLM
scope_entries.finding: Clef reports Decision Index 0.2.1 (43 suites; data not released) and Typesafe workflow evals; Strands reports official JevBench public (176/231 for v21; MIT, benchmarkheaven.com/jev-models, has sealed held-out items, raw task format not found); CLM reports DeepSWE/Terminal-Bench/BFCL, no JevBench; typed-decisions is the shared small community benchmark (KL to gold, Brier, ECE; notes ECE definitions vary).

#18 lists the teacher as a knob (Clef / Clef-flash / another backend) but no per-domain override; Strands' v21 recipe already drops the teacher where its argmax disagrees with gold (config comment 'rows where it agrees with the gold label'), a row-level form of correction. Neither covers a teacher that is wrong where no gold exists or stale on time-sensitive facts, which needs explicit correction records.

jev review already gives the operator a dry-run / --serve (127.0.0.1:18765) / --apply flow over agent-drafted seed entries, with a review file as the append-only record (memory: approval changes nothing in seed.json, the review file is the record); a correction set can reuse that shape instead of a new UI.
check_train_source (assemble.py:316) and the exact/near-duplicate leakage check fail closed on protected sides; correction rows must go through the same gate as teacher-labelled rows.

q8 accepted the recommended dataset mix; q9 sets the correction flow as agent/model-drafted then human-approved/corrected via the UI, which matches the existing jev review dry-run/--serve/--apply shape (c35).
